info.title: roadbeat Studio API — Publishing & Distribution
info.description:
Self-hosted headless CMS — Content Management & Publishing API

**Publishing & Distribution.** Publishing to discovery nodes and content pods, the public Delivery API, exports and outgoing webhooks.

patched.description: Content items that received x-filter metadata

skipped.description: Content items already up to date

url.description: Endpoint URL to receive webhook payloads

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (e.g. BAD_REQUEST, UNAUTHORIZED, NOT_FOUND)

message.description: Human-readable message; validation errors return one message per violation

path.description: Request path that produced the error

requestId.description: Correlation ID (echoes the X-Request-Id header) for support and log lookup

status.description: Outcome for this node. 'skipped' means the node's circuit breaker was open and publishing was not attempted this round.

teaserId.description: ID of the teaser accepted by the node

error.description: Error message when status is failed

enabled.description: Whether publishing to this node is enabled

circuitOpenUntil.description: Until when the circuit breaker stays open; null when closed

lastError.description: Last publish error reported by this node

lastPublishAt.description: When this node last accepted a publish

circuitOpen.description: Whether the circuit breaker is currently open

error.description: Error message of the last failed attempt

node.description: The Discovery Node this record refers to (null if the node was removed)

publicKey.description: PEM-encoded public key (private keys are never exposed)

status.description: Key lifecycle state; 'rotating' keys still verify during the overlap window

total.description: Number of published content items processed

error.description: Error message when the item failed

node.description: Discovery Node ID the backfill targeted

total.description: Number of published content items processed

skipped.description: Items skipped (e.g. no teaser could be generated)

id.description: ID of the new active signing key

publicKey.description: PEM-encoded public key of the new active key

previousKeysValidUntil.description: Until when previously-active keys keep verifying (rotation overlap window)

schema_version.description: Version of the content-type schema the teaser was built against

identifier.description: Content identity: content_id, publisher_id, slug, canonical_url

overview.description: Localized headline, description and hero image

temporal.description: Publication, modification, event and expiry dates

geographic.description: Geographic scope, country codes, cities and locations

metadata.description: Derived metadata (word count, reading time, media flags)

type_filters.description: Content-type-specific filter values extracted from x-filter schema annotations

contentTypes.description: Content type IDs this node accepts
